title: Teriyaki chicken bowl
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet. Cut the broccoli into florets and steam them for the last 4 minutes.
For the teriyaki sauce, mix the soy sauce, honey, grated ginger, crushed garlic, cornflour and 4 tbsp water.
Dice the chicken and fry it in the oil for 5–6 minutes until golden on all sides.
Add the sauce and let it reduce for 1–2 minutes until the chicken is glossy.
Arrange the rice, broccoli and chicken in bowls and sprinkle with spring onions and sesame.
